summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange announcement that its board will meet on November 10, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited quarterly results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, and to authorize publication. Management will host a third-quarter 2026 earnings conference call that day at 7:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time, with a webcast on the investor relations site. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed; this is a routine results-meeting notice, not a special situation.
